description_for_human: Zakelijke assistent voor Promati — haalt informatie direct uit de interne Promati-database via veilige SQL.
description_for_model: Use this tool to answer ALL questions strictly using the Promati internal SQL database. Never use web search. Always call run_sql with SELECT/WITH queries when the user asks about products, packs, schrapers, afdichtingen, klanten, accounts, segmenten, processen, MT, KPI's.
